limitations: Legacy corpus scenes are runs of identical frame_type across 9 fixed samples, not detected shot boundaries; scenes_n is a lower bound on real cuts. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Scatter of scenes_n (frame_labels/scenes derived) against robust_z.
title: Scene count vs performance
